decision_rule_version: issue18-hypotheses-v1; rules fixed before reading results; distance/cover bin edges are right-inclusive (30 m lattice ring belongs to 0-30m on both supports)

H1_boundary_effect.rule: all three pairs: near(0-30 m) disagreement > 1.2x far(120-300 m)

H2_patch_size_effect.rule: CMSA-CMSSM discordance in CMSSM <2500 m2 patch pixels > 1.2x that in >=1e5 m2 patch pixels

H3_coarse_small_patch_omission.rule: zero-GEODATA fraction of 100-900 m2 fine patches exceeds that of >=1e5 m2 patches for both fine products

H4_regional_effect.rule: regional binary Dice range >= 0.10 for every pair

H5_area_vs_patch_agreement.rule: GEO-vs-CMSA national |area bias| < 20% while national binary Dice < 0.70

H6_binary_mixed_pixel.rule: >=5% of GEO=1 pixels carry <50% fine occupancy for both fine products (binary labelling hides mixed support)
